narrative.overview:
A cool paper work surface pairs saturated laboratory blue with warm yellow signals. Condensed headings supply a strong, practical voice; precise ruled records and readable supporting text keep purchase evidence central. The receipt-shaped Sueperman mark remains the identity anchor.

Depth comes from contrasting work surfaces and divisions rather than shadows. Role explanations and case decisions use the same blue workbench vocabulary; explicit preview, replay and provider labels keep the presentation grounded in what the product actually did.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper, laboratory blue and warm yellow signals.
Condensed headings with calm sans-serif supporting text.
Ruled evidence records and flat work surfaces.

rules.name: The Evidence Together Rule
rules.body: Keep identifiers, source modes and observed timestamps close to the finding they qualify.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Separate records with thin rules and changes in surface color; the implemented system uses no box shadows.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: Preserve visible preview, replay and simulation labels; color supports a written state rather than replacing it.

dos: Do use the self-hosted condensed family for headings and the body family for controls and supporting copy.
Do keep case finding, challenge, missing information and deterministic decision visibly distinct.
Do preserve keyboard focus, roving role-tab selection and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't present the role preview as execution progress.
Don't use color alone to distinguish review, rejection or simulation.
Don't hide source modes or imply local approval submits an external claim.
